description:
Speak, don't type

Speak naturally, and Typeless will turn your words into polished messages, emails, and documents that read like you carefully typed them - in real time. 4x faster than typing.
Introducing Help me write

Typeless can now turn simple instructions into the writing you need. With Help me write, just say what you need to communicate with the details that matter. Use it for a reply, an email, a post, or a document.
To use Help me write, press the shortcut for Ask anything and tell Typeless what you need. Or select any text and say how you'd like it refined as you keep working on your writing.
Thanks for using Typeless. We hope this makes writing with Typeless more effortless from start to finish.
